description: Additional read-only consumers and required shared transforms
decisions: Dependency entries record admission patterns; unrelated unfinished write features do not block qualified reader work.
Required codecs and first fuzz targets belong in earlier consuming tracks.
XTS-AES groundwork is not whole-disk unlocking or authenticated encryption.
Reader dependencies remain conditional on safety, license and real-image qualification.
